facts.fact: 7 点闹钟把她拽回——过去两周前一案养成的闹钟。
facts.anchor: seeing that her 7 a.m. alarm—the one she’d been abiding by the last two weeks

facts.fact: 失忆恐慌：怎么回房毫无记忆——开车了？警长送的？
facts.anchor: She had no recollection of it.

facts.fact: 镜前惨状：坟里爬出来的样子——淤青从发际线蔓到眼角、白疤凸显。
facts.anchor: she looked like she’d crawled out of a crypt

facts.fact: 肋骨至少裂了一根——讽刺的是肋骨痛分散了头痛。
facts.anchor: She knew that at least one had to be cracked.

facts.fact: 淋浴念头引发恶心——改水槽浴。
facts.anchor: the thought of water clattering down onto her head enough to uncork the nausea

facts.fact: 药物纪律：讨厌任何让她迟钝/浑浊/脆弱的东西——ibuprofen 是底线；倒几粒只吞一粒其余塞后袋。
facts.anchor: anything that dulled her senses, anything that made her slow, that clouded her thinking, that made her vulnerable.

facts.fact: 无未接来电——April 搜索无果。
门楔没放、链条没扣——违反 cardinal rules；「整本规则都飞出窗外」。
facts.anchor: It seemed like the whole fucking book had gone out the window.

facts.fact: 卡车就停在门口——她自己开回来的；ibuprofen 完全没用。
facts.anchor: Staring back at her was her own truck, parked right in front of her door.
